items.title: Steve Gilmore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: I only met Jaco once and I don’t really know the gentleman, never knew him personally.

ctx.x: That’s good. Your neighbor could come over—

Yeah. Wanna borrow my tool, go ahead. But I play pretty good Fender bass. I’m not up on all the new slapping and pop thumb techniques and everything like that but my idea of good rock & roll is like Aretha Franklin and Motown and all that stuff. But I do own one and can play it reasonably well when called upon to. I’ve done some recording on the Fender bass but not a lot. But as I say I am certainly no Jaco Pastorious, not even close. You know it’s funny, I used to talk to people about it before some of the…
Well Jaco had that thing that you were describing — he had a sound that was identifiable.
